mapper.select: select t.id as applyId, t.apply_type as applyType, t.apply_status as applyStatus, t.apply_time as applyTime, t.apply_person as applyPerson, t.approve_person as approvePerson, t.approve_reason as approveReason, t.apply_reason as applyReason, t.created_time as createdTime, t.updated_time as updatedTime, t.apply_reason as applyReason, td.device_no as deviceNo, td.device_name as deviceName from t_device_apply t inner join t_device td on t.device_id = td.id where t.id = #{applyId}
